items.title: GraphRAG for Engineering Diagrams: ChatP&ID Enables LLM Interaction with P&IDs
items.title_zh: 面向工程图的 GraphRAG：ChatP&ID 让 LLM 与管道仪表图对话
items.summary: ChatP&ID is an agentic framework that converts DEXPI-standard smart P&IDs into knowledge graphs and uses GraphRAG to answer natural-language queries. Across commercial LLM APIs, graph-based representations improved accuracy by 18% over raw images and cut token costs by 85% versus ingesting smart P&ID files, while GPT-5-mini with ContextRAG reached 91% accuracy at $0.004 per task.

items.title: Lie to Me: How Faithful Is Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Reasoning Models?
items.title_zh: 《Lie to Me》：推理模型的思维链有多忠实？
items.summary: The study tests 12 open-weight reasoning models (7B-685B) on 498 MMLU and GPQA Diamond questions with six categories of injected hints across 41,832 runs. Faithfulness ranged from 39.7% to 89.9%; models acknowledged hint influence in thinking tokens about 87.5% of the time but in answer text only about 28.6%.

items.title: STRIATUM-CTF: A Protocol-Driven Agentic Framework for Autonomous CTF Solving
items.title_zh: STRIATUM-CTF：面向自主 CTF 解题的协议驱动智能体框架
items.summary: STRIATUM-CTF is a modular CTF-solving framework that mediates between LLM reasoning and offensive-security tools using MCP, exposing tools as typed, schema-validated functions. In 180 controlled runs it succeeded on 77.8-86.7% of attempts, and it placed first in a single live, non-replicated multi-team CTF at Florida State University against more than 30 registered teams.

items.title: EviSearch: Trustworthy Extraction and Synthesis of Clinical Trial Evidence with Agents that Improve with Use
items.title_zh: EviSearch：用可随使用改进的 Agent 可信地提取与综合临床试验证据
items.summary: EviSearch is a multi-agent system that extracts evidence tables from clinical trial publications and admits a value only after an attribution verifier confirms it on the cited page. Running offline on open-weight models, it reached 91.70% accuracy autonomously and 95.22% after human review of 15.6% of cells on a clinician-annotated benchmark.

items.title: Bridging the Know-Act Gap via Task-Level Autoregressive Reasoning
items.title_zh: 通过任务级自回归推理弥合知与行的差距
items.summary: Using FaultyScience, a new cross-disciplinary benchmark of faulty scientific questions, the authors show LLMs can identify flawed inputs under discriminative prompting but fail to act on that knowledge when generating answers. Their DeIllusionLLM framework models the validate-or-answer decision explicitly and uses self-distillation to reduce answer-despite-error failures.

items.title: Revisiting Quantum Code Generation: Where Should Domain Knowledge Live?
items.title_zh: 重新审视量子代码生成：领域知识应该放在哪里？
items.summary: The study compares a parameter-specialized Qiskit model against general-purpose LLMs augmented with RAG and execution-feedback agents on Qiskit-HumanEval. Fine-tuning reached about 47% pass@1, recent general models reached 60-65% zero-shot or with retrieval, and the strongest model reached up to 85% with iterative execution feedback.

items.title: Mixture of Demonstrations for Textual Graph Understanding and Question Answering
items.title_zh: 演示混合：面向文本图理解与问答的 GraphRAG 框架
items.summary: MixDemo is a GraphRAG framework that uses a mixture-of-experts mechanism to select informative demonstrations for different question contexts, plus a query-specific graph encoder to reduce noise in retrieved subgraphs. Experiments across multiple textual graph benchmarks show it outperforms existing methods.

items.title: OrgForge-IT: A Verifiable Synthetic Benchmark for LLM-Based Insider Threat Detection
items.title_zh: OrgForge-IT：面向 LLM 内部威胁检测的可验证合成基准
items.summary: OrgForge-IT is an MIT-licensed synthetic insider-threat benchmark where a deterministic simulation engine holds ground truth while language models generate only surface prose. It spans 51 simulated days and 2,904 telemetry records at a 96.4% noise rate, and a ten-model leaderboard shows that triage and verdict accuracy can dissociate.

items.title: Graph-Aware Late Chunking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Biomedical Literature
items.title_zh: 面向生物医学文献检索增强生成的图感知后分块
items.summary: GraLC-RAG combines late chunking with structure-aware chunk boundaries, UMLS knowledge-graph infusion and graph-guided hybrid retrieval. On 2,359 PubMed Central articles, structure-aware methods retrieved from up to 15.6x more sections than content-similarity baselines, and KG infusion narrowed the answer-quality gap to a delta-F1 of 0.009.

items.title: Autoresearch on an old research idea
items.title_zh: 用 Autoresearch 推进一个旧研究想法
items.summary: A blogger applied Karpathy's Autoresearch, a constrained optimization loop built around an LLM agent, to old eCLIP research code via Claude Code. The agent iteratively edits train.py to improve an evaluation metric while following instructions in program.md, using a scratchpad file as working memory.

items.title: Show HN: Cq – Stack Overflow for AI coding agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：Cq——面向 AI 编程 Agent 的 Stack Overflow
items.summary: A Mozilla.ai staff engineer presents Cq, a proof-of-concept standard for shared agent learning in which agents propose schema-based knowledge units about gotchas they encounter and query existing ones, with human-in-the-loop review at the team level.
